name: Honeyview (꿀뷰)
summary: Lightweight, fast freeware image viewer that for years was Korea's default comic/manga viewer (꿀뷰). Shows images inside ZIP/RAR/7Z without extracting, double-page mode, EXIF with GPS. Discontinued: no more updates; Bandisoft points users to BandiView.
where_it_wins: Very light and fast on old Windows (XP to 11, 32-bit)
More archive formats (LZH, TAR) and BPG
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon), Honeyview/BandiView-style viewing without Windows or Wine
Plays videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI …) in the same grid and slideshow
Thumbnail grid with folder previews and list view, recursive name search with regular expressions
Free with every feature, no ads, open source, App Sandbox, never goes online
Dual pane with F5/F6 copy/move, undo for file actions
Actively maintained with security updates; HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL support
